mode_revision_basis: M revision in E1-012 after 03 preflight; only direct CUDA with parent RAM monitoring may use 1.5GiB. Default remains 2GiB. This changes resource gate only, not A0 capability criteria.
semantic_rule: A finish answer must mention only the correct red/blue color. Negation or other color words require manual review. Malformed JSON and other tools receive semantic needs_review, independently of their format result.
acceptance: Both private inputs must have actual generated outputs, image tensors, valid local tool actions and correct color semantics; every attempt and failure remains reported. This is compatibility only, never collaboration or general accuracy.
execution_gate: Do not run against E1 until M explicitly supplies a frozen file inventory and SHA-256 values. Criteria/schema adaptation after freeze must be recorded.
